language.label: Language
language.unavailable: Couldn’t load this language. Check the connection to the server running Kinopeer, or open Kinopeer again, then choose the language again.

common.openAgainHint: If you’re sure the server running Kinopeer is on and reachable on your network, your browser may need to confirm its certificate again: open Kinopeer again.

failure.name: Kinopeer’s server can’t find this host. Check the name, or use the IP address.
failure.refused: Nothing listens on this port: check that {{service}} is running, the port, and that it takes connections from the network, not only from 127.0.0.1.
failure.refusedWebUi: Nothing listens on this port: check that qBittorrent is running, the port, and that its Web UI is on and takes connections from the network, not only from 127.0.0.1.
failure.timeout: Nothing answered in time: a firewall may be in the way, or the host is wrong.
failure.http: {{service}} answers here without HTTPS: start the address with http://.
failure.certificate: Kinopeer’s server doesn’t trust {{service}}’s certificate. Use its http:// address.
failure.closed: The connection closed without an answer: check the port, and http:// or https:// at the start.

container.localhostInside: In Kinopeer’s container, localhost and 127.0.0.1 lead into the container itself, not to the computer it runs on.
container.localhostBody: $t(container.localhostInside) Enter the address of the computer {{service}} runs on, or the name of {{service}}’s container if they share a Docker network.
container.localhostBody_host: $t(container.localhostInside) From the container, that computer is at {{address}}. If {{service}} runs in a container on a shared Docker network, enter that container’s name instead.
container.bypassTitle: qBittorrent doesn’t let Kinopeer in without a login
container.bypassBody: Set a password in qBittorrent (Tools → Options → Web UI) and enter its login here. Or, with its auth bypass: qBittorrent sees Kinopeer at {{address}}, and adding {{subnet}} to the subnets it lets in without a login would let Kinopeer in, and everything else that comes from that subnet too.

find.found: Found. Choose an address to use it.
find.none: Kinopeer found no {{service}}. Enter its address.
find.failed: Kinopeer couldn’t look for {{service}}. Try again.

connect.title: Connect qBittorrent
connect.body: Sign in with your qBittorrent Web UI username and password. The Kinopeer server keeps them, so you only do this once.
connect.banned: Too many failed attempts. qBittorrent has blocked this address for a while.
connect.notQbittorrent: The qBittorrent address on the Kinopeer server answers, but not like qBittorrent. Check QBITTORRENT_URL.
connect.unreachableBody: Check that qBittorrent is running and its Web UI is on.
connect.unreachableBody_kinopeer: Check that this device is online and Kinopeer is running on your server.
connect.addressBody: Enter the address of qBittorrent’s Web UI as the Kinopeer server reaches it, and its login. The server keeps them, so you only do this once.
connect.addressHelp: As the Kinopeer server reaches it, for example http://192.168.1.10:8080
connect.addressUnreachable: Nothing answers at this address. Check it, and that qBittorrent is running.
connect.notQbittorrent_app: qBittorrent’s address answers, but not like qBittorrent. Check the address and its port.
connect.hostRefused: qBittorrent refused this address: with Host header validation on, its Web UI takes only its own port and the names in Server domains. Publish it on the same port as inside its container, add the name to Server domains, or turn the validation off.
connect.loginOptional: Leave the login empty if qBittorrent lets Kinopeer in without one.
connect.loginNeeded: qBittorrent asks for a login: enter its username and password
connect.authOff: Kinopeer’s own login is off, so qBittorrent’s address can only be set on the server: QBITTORRENT_URL.
connect.envAddress: qBittorrent’s address is now set on the Kinopeer server (QBITTORRENT_URL), which wins over one from the app.
connect.loginRefused: qBittorrent didn’t accept the username or password.
connect.saveFailed: Couldn’t save the qBittorrent connection. Try again.

unsupported.title: qBittorrent {{version}} is too old
unsupported.body: Kinopeer works with qBittorrent {{min}} or later. Update qBittorrent, then try again.

downloads.emptyBody: Find a movie or series and pick a release — it shows up here with live progress.

speedLimits.failed: Couldn’t switch the speed limits. Try again.

search.noResultsBody: Check the spelling or try the original title.
search.noResultsYearBody: Nothing from {{year}}. Try another year or clear it.
search.errorBody: Check the connection and try again.
search.keyBody: Search needs a TMDB key. Enter it once and the Kinopeer server keeps it.
search.browseEmptyBody: TMDB has no picks at the moment. Try again later, or search by name.

title.subtitle: {{type}} · {{year}}
title.notFoundBody: TMDB has no movie or series with this link.
title.seriesHint: Releases are searched by show name. Pick seasons in the file list after choosing a release.

settings.prowlarrSetup: Not set up, or the API key was rejected
settings.tmdbKey: The API key is missing or invalid
settings.connectionsHint: Service addresses are set in the Kinopeer server configuration.
settings.connectionsHint_app: An address set on the Kinopeer server wins and can’t be changed here. One entered here is checked before it’s kept.
settings.defaultsHint: Used when adding a release, the same on every device. You can still change them for each download.
settings.clearCacheHint: Matches torrents to TMDB titles again
settings.installAppHint: Add Kinopeer to your home screen or dock
settings.ideasHint: In Discussions on GitHub, where ideas are upvoted
settings.reportBugHint: An issue on GitHub with the steps and your versions
settings.sourceCodeHint: Source code, releases and what's changed
settings.tmdbSource: Movie and series data and posters come from TMDB.
settings.tmdbNotice: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
settings.changePasswordHint: Other devices will need to sign in again
settings.passwordFromEnv: The password is set on the server (KINOPEER_PASSWORD), so it’s changed there.
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices will need to sign in again.
settings.changePasswordFailed: Couldn’t change the password. Try again.
settings.signInTurnedOff: Kinopeer’s sign-in was turned off on the server.
settings.foldersHint: Where qBittorrent saves downloads, and each category’s folder

releases.title: Releases
releases.noneBody: Your indexers returned nothing for this title. Try again later or check indexers in Prowlarr.
releases.setupBody: Kinopeer finds releases through Prowlarr. Enter its API key, and the search runs again.
releases.setupBody_address: Kinopeer finds releases through Prowlarr. Enter its address and API key, and the search runs again.
releases.rejectedTitle: Prowlarr didn’t accept the API key
releases.rejectedBody: Its key may have changed in Prowlarr. Enter the current one, and the search runs again.
releases.errorBody: Check that Prowlarr is running and reachable from the Kinopeer server.

add.title: Add to downloads
add.lowSpace: {{free}} free on qBittorrent’s disk, {{missing}} short of this download.
add.lowSpaceSkip: Skip some files or free up space before it finishes.
add.lowSpaceFree: Free up space before it finishes.
add.fetchFailed: Couldn’t get the torrent from Prowlarr.
add.magnetFiles: Magnet link: all files are downloaded. You can skip files later in qBittorrent.
add.addFailed: $t(add.notAdded) It may already be in your downloads.

torrent.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted from qBittorrent.
torrent.errorBody: qBittorrent stopped this torrent because of an error, usually a disk or save path problem. Fix it, then resume.
torrent.missingFiles: The files are missing from the save path. Put them back and resume, or delete the torrent.
torrent.recheckNoMetadata: Once the magnet link has its metadata
torrent.recheckBody: qBittorrent will read the downloaded data of “{{title}}” again. The torrent shows as checking until it’s done, and pieces that fail the check are downloaded again.
torrent.deleteBodyMany_one: {{count}} torrent will be removed from qBittorrent.
torrent.deleteBodyMany_other: {{count}} torrents will be removed from qBittorrent.
torrent.deleteFilesHint: Files are removed from disk permanently.
torrent.priorityFailed: Couldn’t change the priority. Try again.
torrent.filesMetadata: The file list appears once the torrent’s metadata arrives from peers.

match.title: Title match
match.hint: Your choice is saved on the Kinopeer server and shows on every device.
match.saveFailed: Couldn’t save the choice. Try again.
match.unmatched: This torrent isn’t matched to a movie or series

offline.unreachableBody: Check that qBittorrent is running and the Kinopeer server can reach it. $t(offline.retrying).

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: Kinopeer hit an unexpected error. Reload the page to continue.

install.title: Install Kinopeer
install.body: Full screen and a faster launch, like a regular app.

ios.title: Add to Home Screen
ios.subtitle: iPhone and iPad
ios.share: Tap Share in the Safari toolbar
ios.confirm: Tap Add, and Kinopeer opens full screen

mac.title: Add to Dock
mac.subtitle: Safari on a Mac
mac.share: Click Share in the Safari toolbar
mac.confirm: Click Add, and Kinopeer opens in its own window

tmdbKey.title: Connect TMDB
tmdbKey.body: Posters, search and metadata come from The Movie Database. Use a free API key (v3) or read access token. The key stays on the Kinopeer server.
tmdbKey.help: A key is free: sign in to themoviedb.org and copy the API Key or the API Read Access Token.
tmdbKey.label: API key or read access token
tmdbKey.fieldHelp: Kinopeer checks it with TMDB before saving.
tmdbKey.noFallback: Kinopeer has no other TMDB key to use, so the saved one stays.
tmdbKey.forgetFailed: Couldn’t forget the key. Try again.

keyForm.storage: The Kinopeer server couldn’t save the change. Check that its data folder is writable.
keyForm.failed: Couldn’t save the key. Try again.

move.title: Move files
move.absolute: Type the full path, starting with / (or a drive such as D:\ on Windows).
move.note: qBittorrent moves the files in the background, and the torrent carries on from the new folder. It keeps its category, but the category no longer decides its folder.

folders.loadFailed: qBittorrent didn’t send its folders. Try again.
folders.creates: If the folder isn’t there, qBittorrent creates it.
folders.relocates: qBittorrent will move the files of torrents under automatic management that are in this folder to the new one, as its settings say.
folders.toManual: qBittorrent will switch torrents under automatic management that are in this folder to manual mode, as its settings say, and their files stay where they are.
folders.inDefaultNote: Without a folder of its own, the category keeps its torrents in {{folder}}.
folders.categoryGone: qBittorrent no longer has this category. Go back to see the ones it has.
folders.categoryGoneNamed: qBittorrent no longer has the category {{name}}.

category.title: Category
category.moves: qBittorrent will move the files to {{folder}}.
category.movesToCategory: qBittorrent will move the files to the category’s folder.
category.stays: The files are in this category’s folder already: {{folder}}.
category.toManual: qBittorrent will switch the torrent to manual mode, as its settings say, and the files stay in {{folder}}.
category.manual: The torrent is in manual mode, so the files stay in {{folder}}.

prowlarrKey.help: Find the key in Prowlarr: Settings → General → Security → API Key.
prowlarrKey.addressHelp: As the Kinopeer server reaches it, for example http://192.168.1.10:9696
prowlarrKey.addressUnreachable: Nothing answers at this address. Check it, and that Prowlarr is running.
prowlarrKey.notProwlarr_app: Prowlarr’s address answers, but not like Prowlarr. Check the address and its port.
prowlarrKey.label: Prowlarr API key
prowlarrKey.fieldHelp: Kinopeer checks it with Prowlarr before saving. It stays on the Kinopeer server.
prowlarrKey.unreachable: $t(noAnswer.prowlarr). Check that it’s running and try again.
prowlarrKey.notConfigured: The Kinopeer server doesn’t know Prowlarr’s address (PROWLARR_URL).
prowlarrKey.notProwlarr: The Prowlarr address on the Kinopeer server answers, but not like Prowlarr. Check PROWLARR_URL.
prowlarrKey.noServerKey: The Kinopeer server has no Prowlarr key of its own, so the saved one stays.
prowlarrKey.forgetFailed: Couldn’t switch to the server’s key. Try again.
prowlarrKey.saveFailed: Couldn’t save the Prowlarr key. Try again.
prowlarrKey.saveFailed_address: Couldn’t save Prowlarr’s address and key. Try again.
prowlarrKey.envAddress: Prowlarr’s address is now set on the Kinopeer server (PROWLARR_URL), which wins over one from the app.
prowlarrKey.authOff: Kinopeer’s own login is off, so Prowlarr’s address can only be set on the server: PROWLARR_URL.

prowlarrSetup.title: Connect Prowlarr
prowlarrSetup.body: Kinopeer finds releases through Prowlarr. Enter its address as the Kinopeer server reaches it, and its API key. Without Prowlarr everything works but finding releases.

address.invalid: Enter an address that starts with http:// or https://, with no login, ? or # in it

limits.title: Speed limits
limits.invalid: Enter a number from {{min}} to {{max}}, or leave it empty for no limit
limits.failed: Couldn’t save the limits, or saved only some of them. Check the connection to qBittorrent and try again.
limits.failedClosed: Couldn’t save the speed limits of {{title}}, or saved only some. Open them again to check.
limits.markBoth: Speed limits: download up to {{download}}, upload up to {{upload}}
limits.valueBoth: Download up to {{download}}, upload up to {{upload}}

signIn.title: Sign in to Kinopeer
signIn.body: Enter Kinopeer’s password. It keeps everyone else on your network out of Kinopeer and the qBittorrent and Prowlarr behind it.
signIn.setUpBody: Anyone on your network can open Kinopeer, and through it control qBittorrent and Prowlarr. Set a password to keep them out: each device asks for it once.
signIn.alreadySet: Someone has just set Kinopeer’s password. Sign in with it.
signIn.wasReset: Kinopeer’s password was reset on the server. Set a new one.
signIn.throttledMinutes_one: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in {{count}} minute.
signIn.throttledMinutes_other: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in {{count}} minutes.
signIn.throttledHours_one: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in {{count}} hour.
signIn.throttledHours_other: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in {{count}} hours.

telegram.notSetUp: Not set up. Sends a message when a download finishes.
telegram.noChat: Choose the chat to send to
telegram.tokenRejected: Telegram no longer knows the bot’s token. Get a new one from @BotFather and save it here.
telegram.chatRefused: Telegram didn’t deliver to “{{chat}}”: the bot was blocked or removed from it. Send the bot /start and choose the chat again.
telegram.tokenHelp: Create a bot with @BotFather in Telegram and paste the token it gives you. The token stays on Kinopeer’s server.
telegram.tokenInvalid: Telegram doesn’t know this token. Copy it from @BotFather again.
telegram.chatHelp: Send @{{bot}} /start from the chat the notifications should go to (to use a group, add the bot to it first; to use a channel, make the bot its admin and post /start there), then press Find chat.
telegram.noChatFound: No chat sent the bot /start in the last day. Send it and try again.
telegram.botInUse: Another program gets this bot’s messages (a webhook, or an app that polls it), so Kinopeer can’t see /start. Turn that off, or use another bot.
telegram.failedNamed: Couldn’t save Telegram notifications. Try again.
telegram.unreachable: $t(noAnswer.telegram). Kinopeer’s server needs to reach api.telegram.org.

push.name: Push notifications
push.off: Off on this device. Shows a notification when a download finishes.
push.turnOff: Turn off push notifications on this device
push.turnedOff: Push notifications are off on this device
push.turnedOn: Push notifications are on for this device
push.needsHttps: Need Kinopeer opened over HTTPS, with its certificate trusted on this device
push.install: On iPhone and iPad, add Kinopeer to the Home Screen and turn them on there
push.unsupported: This browser can’t show push notifications
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for Kinopeer. Allow them in the browser’s settings for this site.
push.browserFailed: The browser couldn’t turn them on. Try again.
push.invalidEndpoint: Kinopeer doesn’t send through this browser’s push service
push.forgotten: Kinopeer’s server no longer sends to this device. Turn them on again.
push.refused: The push service refused the notification
push.unreachable: The push service isn’t answering. Kinopeer’s server needs to reach it.
push.serverError: Kinopeer’s server answered with an error. Try again, and if it happens again, update Kinopeer.
